found.layerName: Additional HMO Licensing designated area (extracted from Appendix D of the Cabinet report of 19 November 2024)
found.howVerified: The council publishes NO machine-readable boundary, so this was extracted from the PDF and is the only entry here that is derived rather than served. The designated area is a single closed VECTOR path of 775 vertices in the PDF content stream (the earlier note of '1,952 points' was wrong - that counted the separate 3,870-item dark outline path). Both Appendix D sheets carry the identical polygon, related by a pure scale factor of 3.33298 with zero residual. Georeferencing used the OS National Grid 1 km graticule printed on the sheet: the labels are burned into the raster but the gridlines are recoverable by comb-correlation at the scale-implied period (1:75,000 = 37.795 pt/km), locking at 9-11 sigma; 21 vertical and 13 horizontal gridlines gave a least-squares affine with 0.24 px RMS residual (1.5 m), absolute values read from the printed two-digit labels (eastings 466-486, northings 254-266, OS 100 km square SP). THE DECISIVE VALIDATION: the same PDF separately draws the West Northamptonshire Council administrative boundary. Transformed with the grid-derived affine and compared against the official ONS Local Authority Districts December 2024 BFC boundary for E06000062, it matched to median 2.7 m / max 4.4 m across 797 independent vertices; a rigid two-parameter shift of dE -2.00 m, dN +3.75 m collapses that to mean 0.09 m, max 0.31 m. A 2-parameter shift collapsing error to 0.31 m across a 20 km feature demonstrates the transform is correct rather than fitted. OSGB36 to WGS84 via OSTN15 (1.0 m), spot-checked against postcodes.io for NN1 1DE agreeing to 6 decimal places. Overall positional uncertainty 1-2 m. Sanity checks 11/11: area 70.15 km2, 11.6 x 10.8 km, perimeter 43.7 km, valid geometry, 99.99% inside the council area. Independently re-verified here by point-in-polygon against live postcode centroids: NN1 1DE (Castle), NN2 6AA (Kingsley & Semilong), NN5 6LB (Duston) and NN3 8AA (Talavera) are INSIDE; NN11 4AA (Daventry South), NN12 6AA (Towcester) and NN13 7AA (Brackley) are OUTSIDE.
found.caveat: The sheet is titled 'Proposed HMO Additional Licensing CONSULTATION area' and dated 10-07-2024. It is the Appendix D map that both the Cabinet report and the 19 November 2024 decision minute identify as defining the designated area, and no separately published post-decision map exists. Treat the report as authoritative but keep a 'confirm with the council' hedge within roughly 100 m of the boundary.
found.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO THE PRODUCT RECORD: 'Daventry' in the council's phrase 'additional areas in Northampton and Daventry' does NOT mean Daventry town, which is 13.4 km outside the polygon. It refers to the western extension into the former Daventry District (Upton, Duston fringe, toward Harpole/Kislingbury). The designation is a single contiguous polygon around Northampton. Anything treating Daventry town as in-scheme would be wrong. Also, areas-west-northamptonshire.json still states the incorrect 1,952-point figure and should be updated alongside flipping this council from check-boundary to exact point-in-polygon.

found.howVerified: Traced from the council's own checker at https://geoserver.nottinghamcity.gov.uk/myproperty/?c=housing. Its AMD module js/myproperty-data.2.0.2.js loads handler/getValuesHandler.ashx?m=housing&e=<easting>&n=<northing>. Calling that handler for a point in Radford (E455400 N340600) returns an isSelectiveLicensing object naming layerId 29, layerName 'Selective Licensing Designation Boundary (2023-2028)', displayFieldName 'Designation', with attributes {Designation: 'Selective Licensing Designation Boundary (2023-2028)', Website: '.../selective-licensing-consultation-faqs.pdf'} and a 2-ring polygon in EPSG:27700. Calling the same handler for a point in Clifton (E454000 N337000) returns no isSelectiveLicensing key at all, so the layer genuinely discriminates. Every service on maps164 was then enumerated and layer 29 of Core_services/Housing_and_Property/MapServer is that exact layer; a direct geojson query returns 1 MultiPolygon feature, 1504 vertices, bbox lon -1.2202..-1.1015 / lat 52.9289..53.0062, which is Nottingham city and matches the sealed designation's ward coverage (Aspley through St Ann's, excluding Bestwood, Bilborough, Clifton East, Clifton West, Wollaton West). NOT a ward, polling or Article 4 layer: the same service separately carries id 30/31/35 (HMO Additional Licensing 2014-2018 / 2019-2023 / 2024-2028), id 32 (HMO Mandatory), id 33 (Selective 2018-2023 - the SUPERSEDED scheme, do not use), and OpenData/OpenData carries Article_4_Direction_Areas_HMO and Polling_Stations, all of which are distinct layers that were explicitly ruled out.
found.notes: Layer 33 is the superseded 2018-2023 designation - do not use it. Layer 35 (HMO Additional Licensing 2024-2028) returns a null geometry because Nottingham's additional licensing is city-wide; the checker highlights the city boundary for it rather than a designation polygon.

found.howVerified: map.oldham.gov.uk is a Blazor app whose js/map.js proxies all map traffic through ${apiRoot}/api/GetWMSInfo. That proxy forwards to the council's GeoServer (https://oc-aw-p-geoext2.oldham.gov.uk:8443/geoserver/ows, not publicly reachable). A GetCapabilities through the proxy lists 215 layers, of which exactly five sit in the ws_ext_selective_licensing workspace: selective_licensing_webmap through _5, titled 'Selective Licensing Area 1' to 'Area 5', abstract 'Selective Licensing based on 2011 LSOA data'. That matches the council's own record exactly: our areas-oldham.json records 'Five designated areas, known as Area 1 to Area 5' and the map page's own About box says 'These areas have been based on previous LSOA boundaries.' Requesting each layer as KML returns real vector geometry (2152, 1145, 1696, 2236 and 1943 vertices), with five distinct non-overlapping extents inside Oldham (lon -2.1510..-2.0773, lat 53.5122..53.5605), consistent with the designation's named wards (Alexandra, St Mary's, St James, Waterhead, Coldhurst, Werneth, Chadderton South, Hollinwood, Medlock Vale). Ruled out as different layers in the same GeoServer: ws_ext_boundaries:lsoa_oldham (LSOAs), ws_ext_heritage/ws_ext_local_plan_proposals/ws_ext_tpo Conservation Areas, ws_ext_elections Parish Wards. Completeness checked: re-requesting each layer with a bbox four times larger returns byte-identical vertex counts, so the KML is not clipped by the request bbox.
found.notes: One request per layer; substitute the layer name in both the 'layers' parameter and keep 'styles' as ws_ext_selective_licensing:selective_licensing. The proxy REQUIRES service, version, request, srs, bbox, width, height, format, layers, styles and transparent to all be present and non-empty, and it silently DROPS any other parameter (which is why WFS GetFeature cannot be used - typeName never reaches GeoServer).

found.layerName: Brinsworth 2025, Masbrough 2025, Thurcroft 2025, Parkgate 2025, Dinnington 2025, Eastwood 2025 (overlay indices 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)
howToFetch: 1. GET https://maps.rotherham.gov.uk/webmapping/en-gb/PublicMap/Selective%20License and regex out the anonymous JWT from the inline script: 'Authorization':'Bearer <token>'. Also confirms setGeognoSisLayerId = 7e4d80be-50b3-498d-a200-5d477c5e1593 and setBaseUrl = /webmapping/.

2. POST https://maps.rotherham.gov.uk/webmapping/GeognoSis/Selective%20License/7e4d80be-50b3-498d-a200-5d477c5e1593/Sessions with the bearer header and an empty body (Content-Length: 0 is required or IIS returns 411). Response gives sessionId and mapProperties.epsgCode = 27700.

3. POST https://maps.rotherham.gov.uk/webmapping/Selective%20License/Search/GeognoSis/<sessionId>/7e4d80be-50b3-498d-a200-5d477c5e1593/<overlayIndex> with JSON body {"expression": "ST_Intersects(geometry,ST_GeomFromGeoJSON('<a polygon covering the borough>',\"EPSG:27700\"))", "CRS": "27700", "Bbox": "&BBOX=420000,375000,470000,415000"}. Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection in EPSG:27700.

Overlay metadata (name, status) comes from GET https://maps.rotherham.gov.uk/webmapping/GeognoSis/Selective%20License/<layerId>/Sessions/<sessionId>/Overlay/<index>. The host intermittently drops connections; retry with backoff.
found.howVerified: The checker is a Cadcorp GeognoSIS/Web Map Layers app. Its session lists 13 overlays: index 0 'Rotherham District Boundary' (ignoreLayer: true), indices 1-6 named Brinsworth/Dinnington/Masbrough/Parkgate/Eastwood/Thurcroft '2024' with status 0 (hidden), and indices 7-12 the same six names '2025' with status 2 (visible by default on the council's own live map). Each returns exactly one polygon feature whose only real attribute is {"Area": "<place name>"}. The six 2025 names match our areas-rotherham.json record verbatim, which states the scheme is the 'Union of the council's six separate s.80 designations, all made 14 Nov 2025 and in force 15 Feb 2026 to 14 Feb 2031'. The extents are small (each a few hundred metres to ~2.4 km across, e.g. Parkgate E443573-444012 N395070-395848), correctly sub-ward and consistent with the council's own warning that 'not all properties within a street or postcode may be subject to Selective Licensing due to where the boundary falls'. That sub-ward scale is itself proof these are not ward, polling or Article 4 polygons. The 2024-suffixed overlays are the superseded designation and MUST NOT be used.
found.notes: Use ONLY overlay indices 7-12 (the '2025' set) for the in-force 2026-2031 scheme. Index 0 is the borough boundary and indices 1-6 are the superseded 2024 designation. Coordinates are EPSG:27700 and need reprojecting to WGS84.

found.caveat: THIS IS A WARD LAYER, NOT A LICENSING DESIGNATION LAYER. It is included because Lambeth's designation is defined by WHOLE wards, so ward geometry reconstructs it exactly - but only if that whole-ward reading holds. Do not treat this as a designation boundary in the sense Liverpool's KML or Nottingham's layer 29 are.
found.howVerified: No dedicated licensing-designation geometry exists in Lambeth's ArcGIS org. This layer is owned by opendata@lambeth.gov.uk in Lambeth's own org YzAbPjFO62myKADc. The council states its scheme applies to 'all wards in the London Borough of Lambeth, excluding Vauxhall and Waterloo & South Bank'. Querying all 25 features returns exactly the 23 named Phase 1 + Phase 2 wards plus Vauxhall and Waterloo & South Bank - a perfect complement with no gaps, which is what confirms the join. Attributes are OBJECTID, WARD_NAME, NO_OF_COUNCILLORS, CURRENT_ELECTORS, FORECAST_ELECTORS. EXPLICITLY RULED OUT: the 'Ward Checker' link on the council's own selective licensing page is ArcGIS item 9dbda0725bce4175be464cd9d546a49d = 'Wards, Polling Stations Exp Feb 2026' - the polling-stations trap already recorded in our data, confirmed at source. Also ruled out: LambethClaphamSpecialLicencingZone and LambethLicensedPremises (alcohol/premises licensing), LambethArticle4* and LambethPlanningArticle4Direction1-3 (planning control, not licensing), Conservation Areas, and 'Homes Of Multiple Occupancy' (a register of licensed points, not a designation).
found.notes: Name-matching gotcha: the layer spells them Knight's Hill, Myatt's Fields and Streatham St Leonard's while the web page writes Knights Hill, Myatt's Field and Streatham St. Leonard's. Normalise apostrophes, full stops and '&' vs 'and' before joining.

notFound.whatYouTried: Read the checker page at https://www.royalgreenwich.gov.uk/homepage/484/selective_licencing_scheme_lookup in full including its JavaScript: it is not a map at all, just a jQuery UI autocomplete plus a plain form POST, with no iframe, no Esri and no layer config. Probed maps.royalgreenwich.gov.uk (serves a 'Site Maintenance' page; /arcgis/rest/services, /arcgis/rest/info, /server/rest/services, /geoserver/web and /geoserver/wfs?GetCapabilities all 404), gis.royalgreenwich.gov.uk and mapping.royalgreenwich.gov.uk (no DNS). royalgreenwich.maps.arcgis.com is not a real ArcGIS org - /sharing/rest/portals/self falls back to anonymous www.arcgis.com with no org id or urlKey. ArcGIS Online content search for 'Royal Borough of Greenwich' AND licensing returned 0 results; greenwich AND (selective OR 'property licensing') returned only unrelated items. opendata.royalgreenwich.gov.uk does not resolve and data.gov.uk holds nothing from this council. All requests were retried with a browser User-Agent.
notFound.conclusion: No machine-readable boundary is published in any form. The designation exists only as a red-edged polygon on a map annex. HOWEVER the council's checker IS machine-readable at address level and is the only accurate source: GET https://www.royalgreenwich.gov.uk/site/custom_scripts/apps/lookup-selective-licensing/source.php?term=<text> returns a JSON gazetteer (capped at 100 results), and POST https://www.royalgreenwich.gov.uk/homepage/484/selective_licencing_scheme_lookup with address=<exact gazetteer string>&search=Search returns HTML saying either '<address> is covered by the Selective Licensing Scheme' or '<address> does not currently require a Selective Licence.' Verified discriminating: 49 Ann Street SE18 7LS is covered; 61 Woolwich Common SE18 4DE and 1 Adderley Gardens SE9 3EZ are not. CRITICAL: do NOT substitute ward boundaries. The council lists Woolwich Riverside, Woolwich Common, Shooters Hill, Plumstead Common and Plumstead Glyndon, but only PARTS of those wards are designated - 61 Woolwich Common sits in Woolwich Common ward and returns 'not covered', so ward polygons would produce false positives across a large area. Separately, Greenwich's ADDITIONAL HMO licensing (in force 1 January 2024) is borough-wide, so for that scheme the borough boundary for E09000011 is sufficient and no special layer is needed.

notFound.whatYouTried: map.conwy.gov.uk runs Astun iShare, not ArcGIS or GeoServer. The working OWS proxy was found at https://map.conwy.gov.uk/en/getows.ashx?mapsource=mapsources/AllMapsEnglish&service=WFS&version=1.1.0&request=GetCapabilities (valid mapsource values: AllMapsEnglish, MyHouseEnglish, MyNearestEnglish and the Welsh equivalents under /cy/). The entire catalogue was enumerated: 54 WFS feature types on AllMaps, 28 on MyHouse, 32 on MyNearest, 56 WMS layers, plus all three Welsh mapsources - no HMO, selective, additional, licensing or Article 4 layer of any kind exists. The only 'Licen*' matches are Ordnance Survey PSGA licence metadata in layer abstracts. opendata.conwy.gov.uk and data.conwy.gov.uk do not resolve. conwy.maps.arcgis.com exists but returns 0 public items. ArcGIS Online global search for ('houses in multiple occupation' OR 'selective licensing' OR 'additional licensing') AND (wales OR cymru OR conwy) returned 0. DataMapWales lists Conwy as organisation id 61 with count 0 - it publishes nothing there. The three designation PDFs linked from the council's HMO page were re-extracted and each is 1 page with 0 images and 0 tables: no annexed plan, no KML, no street schedule. False positives ruled out by querying them: Llandudno_Neighbourhood_Area (attributes lsoa21cd/lsoa21nm - 2021 census LSOAs), Llandudno_Boundary (one unattributed town-centre polygon in a retail study cluster), Llandudno_Additional_Locations (a venue point layer, keyword collision only), Recreational_Space_Assessment_2023, conwy_wards, conwy_councillors_moderngov and Conservation_Areas.
notFound.conclusion: No licensing designation geometry exists, and ward geometry is NOT a safe substitute here. Two corrections to the brief: there are THREE schemes, not two, and all three are ADDITIONAL HMO licensing, not selective. Critically, the council's own two language versions of the same statutory notice disagree on scope: the English reads 'covering the electoral wards of Glyn and Rhiw' (whole-ward) while the Welsh reads 'o fewn rhan o ward etholiadol Glyn a Rhiw' - 'within PART of the electoral ward'. No published sub-ward boundary exists to reconcile them. Rendering ward polygons as the licensing area would over-cover if the Welsh text is right, telling landlords outside the real designation that they need a fee-bearing licence. Ward membership is safe only as a check-boundary trigger. If a ward-level trigger is wanted, official ward geometry is at https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Wards_December_2024_Boundaries_UK_BFC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=WD24CD%20IN%20('W05001414','W05001428','W05001409','W05001430','W05001416')&outFields=WD24CD,WD24NM,LAD24CD,LAD24NM&outSR=4326&f=geojson (ONS Open Geography Portal, 5 polygons, all LAD24CD W06000003) - Gogarth Mostyn W05001416, Tudno W05001430, Craig-y-don W05001409 (Llandudno & Craig y Don scheme); Glyn W05001414, Rhiw W05001428 (Colwyn Bay scheme); plus Pen-sarn Pentre Mawr W05001427 as the containing ward of the Pensarn street scheme. This is an APPROXIMATION, not the designation.
